purpose: A private read-only data/catalog and Storage export while the workspace cannot connect through the native PostgreSQL protocol. This is not a pg_dump backup and is not certified for full restoration.
scope: All regular and partitioned non-system database tables, including account/Auth and financial records.
Catalog definitions, policies, grants and migration records.
Existing stored-file bytes; the last observed inventory contains five files.
controls: Official CLI credentials stay private; no API key or credential is printed.
Read-only SQL requests and stored-file GETs only; no production data writes, secret rotation, app deployment or hosted test project.
Stored-file metadata is checked again after download; changes stop archive creation.
The encryption key is kept in a separate private directory outside both repositories.
limitations: This custom data/catalog export does not establish full database restoration.
Provider runtime secrets, role passwords, large-object contents and foreign-table contents are not recovered.
Database rows and Storage file bytes are captured separately; cross-service atomic recovery is not certified.
Temporary workspace files are not an off-site backup.

checks: exact byte recovery including large decimal text

approvalReview.action: Custom full production data/catalog export to the local workspace.
approvalReview.statedReason: Sensitive financial/personal data egress; the general backup instruction did not explicitly approve this complete payload and local destination.
